messages:
Sam W: Planning to deploy serving-runtime v2.3 + quant_profile v1.2 to the gold cluster tonight 21:00 UTC. Need one person to run the deploy and one to monitor smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4123

Maria G: I can take the deploy if Jon or Lina can monitor. I'm on-call until 22:00 UTC.

Jon P: I'll monitor. Proposal: canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100%. Cut only if smoke stays green.

Lina: Agreed. Quick Q: do we need any KV cache migration/warmup with the new kernels?

Sam W: No migrations. KV cache shouldn't be invalidated by v2.3, but warmup reduces first-token latency; we'll run a warmup job after we hit 25%.

Jon P: Smoke criteria (agreed): p50 token latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.1%, no model decode hangs > 2s. Any fail = immediate rollback.

Maria G: Rollback steps? want to have commands handy.

Sam W: Rollback commands (copy/paste):
```
./deploy rollback --env gold --to-tag v2.2
kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-engine -n gold
```
Then stop warmup job and re-run smoke suite on v2.2.

Kevin H: I'll run the prod-sim smoke runner and watch long-tail latency: `scripts/smoke.sh --cluster gold --suite quick` and tail the logs.

Sarah L: Note: quant_profile v1.2 enables int4 kernels on Ampere. We ran perf tests on p4d and a100e; watch for decoder warnings and `kv_cache_miss` spikes. If memory jumps >12% on a node, abort.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: https://deploys.redwood.ai/jobs/7891 . Started by Maria G at 2025-06-22T21:00:00Z :rocket:

ops-bot: Automated smoke run started (suite: quick). Expect results in ~4m.

Maria G: Kicking off in 1m. Ping @Jon P @Lina for monitor.

Jon P: watching logs. initial traffic looks normal. no errors in first 60s.

ops-bot: smoke results: p50=98ms, errors=0.02%, no decode hangs. Dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/graph/abc123

Sam W: Good. Proceeding to 25% canary now. Warmup job will start after stable window.

Lina: Warmup job started (pods warming prefixes).

ops-bot: 25% canary smoke: p50=105ms, errors=0.05%, no decoder warnings.

Maria G: If no regressions in 10m we'll ramp to 100%. Kevin, please start long-run stress.

Kevin H: Starting stress run now, tailing any >2s requests and memory metrics.

Sarah L: Reminder: if you see `decoder::misalign` or repeated `kv_cache_miss` spikes, hold ramp and investigate.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% initiated by Maria G at 2025-06-22T21:30:00Z.

ops-bot: Final smoke check (100%): p50=113ms, errors=0.06%, no hangs, memory delta within expected bounds.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: serving-runtime v2.3 + quant_profile v1.2 @gold at 2025-06-22T21:35:00Z. Deployed by Maria G :tada:

Sam W: Nice work team. We'll run a light post-deploy quality check tomorrow (model outputs + evals). Thanks all :clap:
